assets.title: Aurilia beneath the long winter
assets.source: Established setting: Auril's long winter; existing w4 narration
assets.visual_review: Reviewed: coherent winter panorama, visible patrol and warm settlements; interpretive environment, not map-accurate geography.

assets.title: Campess Port — where it began
assets.source: Sessions 1–6 and public location entry: Campess Port, southern port
assets.visual_review: Reviewed: readable harbour, warmer southern-coast palette, no labels; generic dock workers, interpretive architecture.

assets.title: Muttonham — a town worth defending
assets.source: Sessions 9–17; map/location: Muttonham valley
assets.visual_review: Reviewed: modest walled market town, river and mountains; interpretive earlier establishing view, architecture is not a canonical town plan.

assets.title: Muttonham — hold the fallback line
assets.source: Sessions 15–17; barricades, ballistae, Frost Wardens and fallback defence
assets.visual_review: Reviewed: Ulrick and Durzo identities retained, readable barricade and ballista, approaching ice forces; glaive tip near top edge, avoid extra crop.

assets.title: Wavecrest — the town remembers
assets.source: S17-15012; public Session 17 summary; wavecrest request
assets.visual_review: Reviewed: Nate likeness and clothing retained; readable celebration and knight salute; raised hand and sword meet upper edge, avoid top crop. Crowd and knight appearance are illustrative.

assets.title: Skycrest — the ancient airship
assets.source: Sessions 49–50; existing SKYCREST loose-design reference
assets.visual_review: Reviewed: coherent ornate airship and propellers, warm cabin lights, no weapons firing. Upper balloons are cropped by the generator; use as a medium-wide view, not an entire-ship silhouette.

assets.title: The Nimbus Coronet — fire imprisoned in ice
assets.source: Existing s2 narration and trailer-skycrest-crown request
replace: GOD_AURIL crown + G_AGNI used for the trapped avatar
assets.visual_review: Reviewed: icy crown, enclosed flame, open casket and airship deck all readable. Distant ice architecture is symbolic background, not a canonical flight location.

assets.title: Chronos — the still moment aboard ship
assets.source: Public gods page: ship frozen in time beside grandfather clock
assets.visual_review: Reviewed: original bespectacled Chronos retained, ship setting, readable grandfather clock and suspended motion. Decorative marks on foreground scroll are not campaign text; clock top touches edge.

assets.title: Nyxara — the temple beneath Campess Port
assets.source: Session 4 public summary: sealed temple beneath sewers
replace: new NYXARA_TEMPLE; do not assume G_NYX is this scene
assets.visual_review: Reviewed: hooded white-eyed Nyxara, flooded ancient sanctuary, clean central composition. Temple architecture is interpretive; no extra living deity.

assets.title: Mount Mistmourne — the house of ghosts
assets.source: Session 33: haunted house on Mt Mistmourne; source interior mood
assets.visual_review: Reviewed: clear ominous doorway, mountain context and restrained ghosts; exterior architecture is interpretive. Dark image benefits from gentle grading, not further darkening.

assets.title: Nate and Lyrial — the haunted house aftermath
assets.source: S33-8040; Sessions 33–34; existing haunted-house request
assets.visual_review: Reviewed: two distinct established characters, non-graphic death scene and ghosts. Feet extend toward frame edges; retain faces and resting hands during reframing.

assets.title: Nate Wavecrest — captain and warlock
assets.source: Public hero identity; P_NATE is 220px
assets.visual_review: Reviewed: red hair, human ears, navy coat, pendant and stubble retained; left region available for title. Symbolic living portrait, not a newly claimed event.

assets.title: Lyrial Thorne — smuggler and bard
assets.source: Public hero identity; P_LYRIAL is 220px
assets.visual_review: Reviewed: half-elf ears, braids, green eyes, brown leather, coin and lute readable. Symbolic portrait; decorative coin markings are not campaign inscriptions.

assets.title: Gavin — the would-be rescuer
assets.source: Public Gavin hero entry; P_GAVIN 220px; Session 39
assets.visual_review: Reviewed: rugged face, brown hood and plain equipment retained; cold prison setting and readable face. Detailed interpretation from a small 220px source.

assets.title: The fallen — Nate and Lyrial remembered
assets.source: Public fallen biographies; existing G_MEMORY memorial graphic
assets.visual_review: Reviewed: both likenesses retained, soft symbolic memory treatment, no generated names or dates. No literal resurrection implied; editor adds memorial typography.

assets.title: Ulrick — the promise he could not keep
assets.source: S34-4496 and existing ulrick-edderick request; vision/memory
assets.visual_review: Reviewed: Ulrick likeness and armour retained, restrained expression, coherent clasped gauntlets and brother mostly off-frame. Use as memory/vision illustration, not current battle aftermath.

assets.title: Durzo and Elara — a debt in shadow
assets.source: Public Durzo biography and elara-at-the-gate request; symbolic relationship portrait
assets.visual_review: Reviewed: Durzo retains silver hair and red-black clothing; Elara remains an indistinct violet apparition. Symbolic relationship image, not a new literal rescue scene.

assets.title: Gideon — the World Tree awakens
assets.source: S57-9626; public Session 57; existing gideon-world-tree request
assets.visual_review: Reviewed: fairy scale, insect wings and dark robes retained; first green growth climbs a largely dead World Tree. Ring is too small to read clearly. Illustrative Session 57 awakening.

assets.title: D.E.R.E.K. and B.0.B. — aboard Skycrest
assets.source: Public hero identities; Sessions 49–50 airship and father/son bond
replace: BOB_BOLT when no attack is being described
assets.visual_review: Reviewed: distinct single blue eyes, red lips and correct father/son scale. Grapes readable. Scenic background includes another airship and a fanciful mountain city; use as symbolic relationship montage, not an exact voyage record.

assets.title: Blibdoolpoolp — the abyss answers
assets.source: Established public Sea Mother identity and sea/madness domain; symbolic divine manifestation
assets.visual_review: Reviewed: skeletal sea-witch identity, skull/driftwood crown, serpent forms and small vessel are readable. Crown tips reach top edge despite requested margin; preserve full frame. Symbolic domain image, not an actual new ship encounter.
